description: Investigate gate_orchestrator daemon in ERROR state (age 5h16m). Query service_health for gate_orchestrator status and last_error. Check if gate_orchestrator.py exists on disk. Inspect logs for Python traceback. Output: (a) current error state from service_health, (b) daemon file existence, (c) recent log excerpt if available, (d) recommendation (restart needed vs. code fix required). Must use write_service :8772 for health queries. Handler: diagnostic_report.
